fileState-clip.label: Clip
fileState-clip.tip:
Clip area of icon
$Related command
Load Image

fileState-inherit.label: Inherit
fileState-inherit.tip:
Inherits specified state's attributes, events, and scripts
If the same attribute exists, it overrides the inherited state's attribute value
If the same type of event exists, it overrides the inherited state's event
Overridden events can still be triggered using the 'Call Event' command
However, inherited scripts will stack instead of being overridden

fileState-attributes.label: Attributes
fileState-attributes.tip:
Initial attribute list
$Optional types
Boolean, Number, String, Enumeration(String)
$Related commands
Set Boolean, Set Number, Set String

fileState-events.label: Events
fileState-events.tip:
A list of state events
Access "Skill Caster" to get the actor who cast the skill to create this state
Access "Event Trigger Actor" to get the actor with this state
Access "Event Trigger State" to get this state
$Optional types
Add State: Triggered when the actor adds this state
Remove State: Triggered when the actor removes this state
Custom: Triggered by the "Call Event" command

fileState-scripts.label: Scripts
fileState-scripts.tip: Add script files to extend this state
